h1: Custom Snugz Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Snugz badges in bulk. Durable, no-pinch badge holders with clear vinyl pouches. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Snugz badges are the no-pinch solution for frequent badge users. Their patented rounded edges and soft plastic design prevent snagging on clothes, making them ideal for daily-wear environments like hospitals, warehouses, and retail stores. Choose from standard or slimline sizes, with clear vinyl pouches that keep IDs visible and secure. Add your logo or text with screen printing or foil stamping for a professional look.
heroAltText: Custom Snugz badges with rounded edges and clear vinyl pouches, ideal for ID badge holders in bulk orders.
